recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied Jira correction for the current source by aligning the links with the CodeSystem URI used for token systems, without changing search semantics or requiring broader terminology work.
issue_request: FHIR-25124 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that the boolean token-search special-values URL/link be corrected from the obsolete http://hl7.org/fhir/special-values reference.
initial_application: Commit 7b2d96b1ef0a applied FHIR-25124 by changing the boolean token row, explanatory note, and summary-table text in source/search.html to use http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/special-values. Later commit d382fc3af52 changed the local Special Values hrefs to external THO ValueSet pages, leaving CodeSystem URI text and code-system prose linked to the ValueSet page.
additional_context: source/search.html is current build source for the search page; source/fhir.ini maps boolean to token in [search-rules] and notes that search.html carries the summary table. THO publishes distinct CodeSystem and ValueSet pages for special-values, and the ValueSet includes the CodeSystem. Because a token search system is a code system identifier, the existing CodeSystem URI text is the correct semantic target. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-04-06 confirmed the FHIR-25124 vote, and no conflicting Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Changed the two boolean-token Special Values hrefs in source/search.html from https://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet-special-values.html to https://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem-special-values.html. The code system URI text and token summary behavior were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/search.html:3600 changed the boolean token implicit-system hyperlink target from the THO ValueSet page to the THO CodeSystem page.
source/search.html:3623 changed the Special Values code-system prose hyperlink target from the THO ValueSet page to the THO CodeSystem page.
